grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in grid_str.splitlines()]
# BFS components of !=7
from collections import deque
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(16):
 for c in range(16):
  if grid[r][c]!=7 and (r,c) not in seen:
   q=deque([(r,c)]);seen.add((r,c)); cc=[]
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft();cc.append((x,y))
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=nx<16 and 0<=ny<16 and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
      seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
   comps.append(cc)
[( (min(x for x,y in cc), min(y for x,y in cc), max(x for x,y in cc), max(y for x,y in cc)),len(cc),sorted({grid[x][y] for x,y in cc if grid[x][y] not in (0,7)})) for cc in comps]
